title: Head of Public Policy, Latin America
description:
Discord is used by over 200 million people every month for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does on our platform: play video games. Over 90% of our users play games, spending a combined 1.5 billion hours playing thousands of unique titles on Discord each month. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.

As Discord’s Head of Public Policy for Brazil and Latin America, you will be responsible for building trust and finding common ground with policymakers, regulators, and other stakeholders in Brasilia and national capitals across Latin America. This role can be resident in Sao Paulo or Brasilia and will report to the Head of Americas Public Policy.

What you will do

  1. Introduce Discord to government policymakers and civil society stakeholders in key markets across the region, including educating decision-makers on our founding vision, our products, and our investments in privacy and safety;
  2. Develop and execute a multi-year government advocacy strategy that maps the interests of Discord users and the company’s business goals to the evolving legal and regulatory landscape in those key markets;
  3. Identify emerging trends in the regulation of online communications services and build action plans responsive to these trends in coordination with our Legal, Product, and Communications teams;
  4. Advocate for Discord’s position on key legislative and regulatory initiatives that will impact our users and our business, balancing direct advocacy with effective leverage from coalitions and associations;
  5. Provide context and support for the company’s responses to regulator inquiries;
  6. Promote employee awareness and invite employee engagement on our public policy strategy and priorities;
  7. Engage in public policy coalitions with peer companies and civil society organizations;
  8. Coordinate and drive compelling returns from the company’s partnerships with non-profits and civil society organizations;
  9. Manage the company’s government affairs consultants and advisors in Latin America.

What you should have

  1. Sustained (7+ years) professional success at the highest levels of government and/or in strategic public policy advocacy
  2. Experience developing and executing public policy advocacy campaigns in Brazil, with experience in other key markets (Mexico, Argentina, Chile) in the region a plus
  3. Insight on the policymaking process in key markets throughout the region
  4. Commitment to Discord’s mission to be the place where everyone can find belonging before, during and after playing games together online
  5. Willingness to travel as necessary within the region, with occasional travel to the U.S. as required

Bonus Points

  1. Work experience on technology policy initiatives such as online safety, privacy, cybersecurity, or content moderation, especially in the online gaming space
  2. Ability to translate complex technical information into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical audiences
  3. Leadership experience with a civil society organization and/or tech company
  4. Success building trust and consensus across stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Come join the BEST and the BIGGEST team in HVAC: Service Experts Heating, Air Conditioning, & Plumbing!

Position Summary:

Under minimal supervision, performs diagnostic and service work on residential and/or light commercial HVAC equipment and accessories. Communicates with customer to answer questions, resolves problems, and ensures complete customer satisfaction. Promotes products and services to customer.Works under the direction of the Field Supervisor or General Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Works under minimal supervision to perform residential and/or light commercial service and maintenance calls
  • Analyzes, diagnoses, and resolves customer problems in a courteous, professional, timely, and accurate manner
  • Diagnoses and performs services on heating, air conditioning, ventilation, and refrigeration equipment as well as accessories in an accurate and timely manner
  • Inspects equipment and performs diagnostics on equipment to identify potential problems to prevent premature and unexpected breakdowns or callbacks
  • Completes routine maintenance and equipment cleaning as needed or required
  • Responsible for delivery and removal of parts and equipment needed to complete service work
  • Using hand-held device records all required information on customer call. Completes all forms and paperwork in a neat, timely, complete, and accurate manner. Collects payment from customer.
  • Communicates with dispatch, while on duty, to ensure dispatcher has an accurate status report of activities and availability
  • Responsible for delivery of excellent customer service and sustaining high levels of customer satisfaction
  • Promotes products and services to the customer. Calls Sales and Service Coordinator with specifics on replacement product sales leads generated from customer service visit.
  • Ensures company property, vehicles, and tools are being used, maintained, and properly accounted for
  • Represents the company professionally, honestly, and ethically in all business matters and activities
  • Follows standard procedures and process, ensures that the company vehicle is properly stocked, returns defective warranty parts to the branch, and orders/replenishes vehicle stock as needed
  • Performs similar/other duties as needed or assigned

Health & Safety Roles and Responsibilities :

  • Reports any unsafe acts, conditions and hazards to direct supervisor/manager immediately
  • Reports any contravention of legislation or company policy, procedure or program to direct supervisor/manager immediately
  • Corrects substandard acts or conditions within area of control
  • Uses and maintains appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) as prescribed by company program(s) or procedure(s)
  • Never removes or renders ineffective safety guards, devices, or clothing prescribed to be in place or worn
  • Complies with the general rules as prescribed by company program(s) procedure(s)
  • Operates devises or equipment as prescribed by company program(s) or procedure(s)
  • Participates in any safety initiatives, teams, or committees
  • Reports all injuries or incidents as prescribed by company program(s) or procedure(s) immediately
  • Provides input on developing safety initiatives and plans to eliminate exposures that could cause accidents
  • Does not perform act that may endanger the safety or well-being of others
  • Does not engage in any pranks, contests, or rough boisterous behavior
  • Works in compliance with applicable legislative requirement

Desired Skills and Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED with additional training and 2 to 5 years’ experience in HVAC with technical training certification required
  • Must possess all valid licensing or certification as required by federal, state, provincial, or local governmental laws or regulations for the geographical work area
  • EPA and safety certifications required
  • Skilled at servicing heating, air conditioning, and ventilation equipment as well as related accessories
  • Proficient mechanical aptitude and the ability to operate all necessary tools and equipment
  • Proficient and able to operate all necessary tools and equipment to perform various service projects
  • Proficient at reading wiring diagrams and troubleshooting problems with electrical, refrigerant and duct systems on HVAC equipment
  • Proficient and able to properly start up and balance airflow and to properly align belts and pulleys on all systems with little to no supervision
  • Proficient and able to install a basic duct fitting
  • Proficient at troubleshooting and repairing electronic air cleaners, refrigeration systems, hot water systems, steam boiler systems, humidifiers, and related equipment with little to no supervision
  • Effective communication skills to communicate with customer and resolve customer issues, complaints, or concerns
  • Effective and efficient time-management and organizational skills
  • Valid driver’s license with acceptable driving record
  • Available to work flexible hours and on-call shifts as needed
  • Ability to stand and walk and to climb ladders and attic stairs and to maneuver in attics, basements, and crawl spaces to access HVAC units. Ability to continually climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and/or crawl.
  • Ability to work in a variety of environmental conditions, including but not limited to the following: hot, cold, outdoor, indoor, dry, humid, slippery surfaces, heights, and congested areas
  • Ability to safely climb 300lb load capacity rated ladders with a 30lb tool belt
  • Natural or corrected vision to see and focus for close, distance, peripheral vision with normal depth perception
  • Ability to lift up to 75 pounds and ability to lift and carry items weighing up to 50 pounds

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at .

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual or developmental disability
  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
  • Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
  • Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports
  • Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
  • Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities
  • Partial or complete paralysis (any cause)
  • Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema
  • Short stature (dwarfism)
  • Traumatic brain injury

title: Account Executive
description:
Tactiq is a rapidly growing global Series A SaaS startup headquartered in Sydney, that uses generative AI to extract actionable knowledge from conversations. Our mission is to transform how teams capture and utilize conversational insights to drive productivity and innovation. Over 600,000 users across 10,000 organizations in the US, EU, and LatAm, including Fortune 500 and ASX50 companies, love us, and we're ready to take the South American market to the net new level together.

We're seeking a driven and experienced self-starter Account Executive in Brazil, Sao Paolo, preferably, to spearhead our further expansion across Brazil and South America. As our first dedicated sales hire in Brazil, you'll be instrumental in establishing Tactiq as the go-to solution for mid-corporate and enterprise teams seeking to maximize the value of their meetings. Working hand-in-hand with a ‘playing coach’ Sales Manager, you will also be supported by a Customer Success Manager in your time zone, a sales engineer, and a powerful marketing team to ensure your efforts are converted into success in a controllable way.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive the Full Sales Cycle: From initial contact to closing deals, you'll own the sales process for enterprise and mid-corporate accounts.
  • Identify and Qualify Leads: Leverage multiple outbound channels and prospecting skills to identify key decision-makers and qualify high-potential leads using ICP metrics.
  • Manage Pipeline: Maintain an accurate balanced CRM pipeline. Provide confident data-driven forecasts and iteratively develop key account plans.
  • Conduct Product Demonstrations: Showcase the power of Tactiq through compelling product demos tailored to the specific needs of each prospect.
  • Build Relationships: Develop and nurture strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders and product champions, becoming a trusted advisor on meeting productivity.
  • Close Deals: Consistently meet and exceed sales targets, driving ARR and expansion growth for Tactiq in the Brazilian and South American market.
  • Full-stack Sales Professional: You are a subject matter expert in technology sales. Having had a wide-ranging experience, you use professional concepts and company objectives to resolve multiple tasks and issues in creative and effective ways.
  • Hunter Mentality (a cliche line that works ;)))): You are a self-starter who thrives on the thrill of the chase and isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves and get your hands dirty.
  • Multi-lingual: Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory. Knowledge of Spanish is highly advantageous as well.
  • Multi-tenant Sales Targeting: You own a history of selling into various customer audiences (not just technical or business). You confidently address different customer queries and use cases through multiple angles of a product.
  • Enterprise/Mid-Corporate Sales Experience: Proven track record of success selling SaaS solutions to enterprise and mid-corporate clients.
  • Working knowledge of PLG: You know product-led sales and can easily distinguish a PQA from a PQL to execute an efficient lead-generation process.
  • Great Visual Thinker: You project a holistic picture of account development journey over 12-18 months, from initial activation to company-wide coverage.
  • SaaS/AI/Cloud expertise: You confidently operate knowledge about LLMs, SSO, SAML, SOC2 and feel comfortable around technical and regulative concept landscape.
  • Strong Qualifier: Professional in qualifying IN and OUT to ensure efforts are applied to the tangible and closable opportunities only.
  • Deal Engineer: You construct non-standard commercial solutions to fit customer economics and provide long-term commercial benefits.
  • Sales tech-savvy: Strong knowledge of outreach tools (Apollo, Luna.ai, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator), CRM power user (Hubspot) and enrichment platforms (Skrapp.io, Rocketreach).
  • Solid Storytelling Skills: You put customer problems first and give compelling reasons to transfer from As Is to To Be state.
  • Results-Oriented: Driven by a desire to achieve and exceed targets, with a focus on delivering measurable results.

What is the Tactiq style?

  • Concise, make-it-happen approach.
  • A dynamic collaborative culture that values rapid feedback, empowerment, and openness.
  • Fast decision-making based on sanity-check, common sense, and universal business laws to ensure all decisions get us closer to the strategic business goals.
  • Work-life balance. Being a global team empowered by various cultural backgrounds, we get the importance of life outside work to make every working hour count.
  • We aim to run from ideation to shipment in hours or days.

Why would you join?

  • Be a Pioneer: Capitalize on the existing strong position and shape the future of Tactiq in the Latin American, with a direct impact on our fast-paced growth and success. Design your territory plans and GTM strategies that will get you to the results.
  • Uncapped Potential: Enjoy a competitive salary, commission structure, and opportunities for professional development.
  • Innovative Culture: Work alongside a talented and passionate team that's dedicated to pushing the boundaries of productivity.
  • Make a Difference: Help teams worldwide unlock the power of productivity. Act as the voice of the customer, providing valuable feedback to our product team to ensure Tactiq continues to meet the evolving needs of our users.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in Brazil (Sao Paolo preferred), actively collaborating with our Australian and global teams.
  • A pathway into AI: Take the next step in your career to learn and harness the power of AI technology.
  • Standard equipment includes MacBooks, with the flexibility to provide whatever tools you need to excel in your role.

Thousands of our users believe in our product by giving it 5-star reviews on the Chrome web store. Try Tactiq before applying here:

Programa Jovem Aprendiz:

O nosso programa tem a missão de promover a inserção de jovens no mercado de trabalho. E esse objetivo tem tudo a ver com o propósito do Itaú: estimular o poder de transformação das pessoas.

Procuramos jovens com muita disposição e vontade de aprender!

Acreditamos que a diversidade de talentos com diferentes histórias, formações, experiências e habilidades nos ajudarão a construir um Itaú Feito de Futuro!

Temos vagas no Brasil inteiro!

Quem somos?

Somos um banco que busca ser cada vez mais digital nas soluções e humano na experiência e no contato com as pessoas. Queremos encantar os nossos clientes, no Brasil e nos demais 17 países em que o Itaú Unibanco está presente, com soluções que atendam suas necessidades e expectativas.

Apostamos no poder da tecnologia e das pessoas para conectar e transformar a experiência dos nossos clientes para melhor. Por isso, buscamos talentos que queiram ser protagonistas dessa evolução e parte de um time sempre antenado em tendências e inovações. Queremos ser a empresa que as pessoas – de todas as raças, idades, classes sociais, e orientações sexuais, com ou sem deficiência – escolham como lugar onde vão se desenvolver e contribuir para a realização de sonhos: delas, do banco e dos nossos clientes.

O primeiro passo da sua carreira pode ser aqui!


Nosso programa é dividido em 3 principais áreas de atuação, entenda como funciona cada uma delas:

Rede de Agências:

As agências fazem parte de um dos principais canais para falar diretamente com o cliente, onde o objetivo é encantar e proporcionar uma experiência de excelência.

Atividades que a pessoa aprendiz realiza:

  • Recepcionar e realizar abordagem inicial com clientes
  • Organizar filas de atendimento
  • Auxiliar os clientes quanto ao uso das ferramentas tecnológicas

Empresa Redecard (Empresa do Itaú Unibanco):

O Itaú possui diversas empresas em seu grupo, uma delas é a Rede. A Rede é dona daquela famosa maquininha laranja, responsável por facilitar o pagamento de muitos estabelecimentos.

Atividades que a pessoa aprendiz realiza:

  • Auxiliar na satisfação do cliente

  • Apoio na emissão de relatórios da área

Corporativo:

São vagas para áreas administrativas/internas, disponível apenas em São Paulo.

Atividades que a pessoa aprendiz realiza:

  • Contato com ferramentas: Excel e PowerPoint e dependendo da área: programação em linguagens Java e etc.

As competências são diferentes de acordo com a área, mas de forma geral, buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com a nossa cultura e estejam dispostas a aprender!

title: Sr. Strategy & Operations Analyst
description:
Company Overview


Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Analyst to join our Sales Analytics team. In this role, you will focus on building scalable data models, launching and maintaining Tableau dashboards, and providing actionable sales insights that drive performance and strategic decision-making. You will also play a key role in supporting the creation and maintenance of decks for executive presentations. Additionally, you will be responsible for pulling data for these decks and running ad-hoc queries to address evolving business needs. Working closely with both Sales and Sales Operations teams, you'll ensure data infrastructure is optimized and reporting processes are efficient, helping to drive the overall success of the Sales organization.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Senior Manager of Sales Analytics.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain scalable, high-performance data models in Snowflake that support sales reporting and analytics
  • Ensure the accuracy and consistency of data across systems, automating and optimizing data pipelines where necessary
  • Support the continuous improvement of data architecture to ensure that the analytics platform is scalable and reliable
  • Identify and resolve issues related to data reporting and dashboard performance
  • Develop and maintain dashboards
  • Design, implement, and manage Tableau dashboards to track sales performance, key performance indicators, and key business metrics for Sales Leadership
  • Collaborate with Sales and Operations Teams to define reporting needs and deliver actionable insights via Tableau and other visualization tools
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enhancements to Tableau dashboards, ensuring they remain up-to-date with business requirements
  • Ensure proper data governance, consistency, and quality across Sales analytics processes
  • Assist in defining and monitoring Sales metrics, helping drive better decision-making through actionable insights
  • Run ad-hoc queries to gather data and provide insights in response to business requests and evolving needs
  • Communicate complex data insights clearly to non-technical partners, providing recommendations for action
  • Assist in creating and updating decks for executive presentations, communicating data insights and performance metrics
  • Pull and analyze data from various sources to support the creation of decks, ensuring insights are accurate and relevant
  • Collaborate with partners to ensure insights are effectively presented in a clear and visually compelling manner
  • Present data-driven findings and recommendations to senior leadership and other business units as needed

Job Designation

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • 2+ years of experience in Sales Strategy, Sales Operations, or a related field, preferably in SaaS or technology industries
  • 2+ years of experience with SQL (experience with Snowflake preferred), data modeling, excel and BI tools such as Tableau, or Salesforce CRM Analytics
  • Experience building scalable data models and working with business intelligence tools, especially Tableau
  • Experience with data modeling, SQL, and data visualization
  • Experience with Salesforce or other CRM systems, and integrating data from these systems for analytics purposes
  • Ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field

Preferred

  • Intuition for business with a solid understanding of basic sales metrics (e.g., revenue, conversion rates, pipeline, quota attainment) and key performance indicators to support data-driven decision-making
  • Experience in SaaS, B2B Sales operations, or high-growth startups
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities effectively

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at for assistance.

Qualifications
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in maintaining and optimizing large, multi-site, complex contact center environments.

  • Proven track record in developing and managing routing and IVR workflows using the Genesys Architect tool.
  • In-depth knowledge of infrastructure planning, operations, design, deployment, and system lifecycle management to maintain high availability and performance.
  • Strong understanding of business processes and their connection to customer experience technology, enabling optimized solutions.
  • Comprehensive understanding of SIP infrastructure, including SIP protocol, Session Border Controllers (SBC), and load balancing solutions, ensuring reliable and scalable communication networks.

Nice to have:

  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join oursustainable business practicesfocused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ECOSEC

What We Do

Our ECOSEC team provides a safer experience for Epic's users. We work across multiple products and services to improve technology and craft transparent policies so our players and users can have positive experiences on our platforms.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Backend Security Engineer focused on Asset Integrity to protect sensitive game assets from unintended information disclosure. Your efforts will be critical to the success of Fortnite and the many creators who depend on it. The ideal candidate will be well-versed in backend development and have prior experience developing security features. This is an incredible opportunity to contribute to the next generation of Epic’s game development tools.

In this role, you will

  • Directly contribute code and be a code owner for multiple services and code bases
  • Collaborate with the Fortnite, Unreal Engine, and Epic Games Store teams to understand the security implications of existing and upcoming features, proposing changes if appropriate
  • Work with internal and external UEFN development teams, including well-known brands, to address concerns about asset integrity and information disclosure
  • Investigate technical root causes of unintended information disclosure incidents
  • Proactively seek out components in Fortnite backend services that create asset integrity risks, then clearly communicate the problem and recommended solution
  • Build and improve internal tooling at scale to protect the Epic creator ecosystem
  • Handle various real-time issues that may arise on online services and platforms

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, with experience in backend development for games
  • Expert knowledge in one or more of the following programming languages: C++, Java, Go, or TypeScript
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems and design patterns
  • Strong knowledge of AWS/Cloud infrastructure including code-as-infrastructure (e.g. Terraform)
  • Experience building & managing distributed systems, designing APIs, and deploying services (e.g. Kubernetes)
  • Experience working with data analytics to solve, prevent, or monitor for problems
  • Knowledge and/or experience mitigating security vulnerabilities in sandboxes / virtual machines and potential mitigation strategies
  • Experience building or working with CI/CD environments
  • Experience working with building and deploying container images

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Join to apply for the Remote Site Engineer (IP/Network) role at Speedcast

Overview Of Position
The Sr. IP Network Engineer is an individual contributor with advanced background in IP Network Engineering design, implementation and operation.

Overview Of Position
The Sr. IP Network Engineer is an individual contributor with advanced background in IP Network Engineering design, implementation and operation.
The primary objective of the Sr. IP Engineer within the Edge Network Engineering team is to properly identify customer requirements and establish and deploy a solution which meets the customer’s needs and expectations. This will require disciplined compliance with change management best practices while working both independently and with cross-functional teams; this role will have opportunities to coach team members on complex technical issues, interface with other engineering and support groups internally, and engage with customer IT personnel on complex network/system performance and troubleshooting efforts.
This Sr. IP engineer position provides customer facing global IP network design and implementation, hardware selection and configuration standardization as it relates to network routing protocol, switching and security methodology. As part of the Edge Network Engineering team, the role also includes Tier 4 escalations from the global support organization as well as providing pre-sales technical consultation alongside Sales and Solutions/Systems Engineering teams.
What you will do:

  • Build and maintain customer’s IP network infrastructure within Speedcast Edge network
  • Enforcing Cyber Security policies and hardening of non-core managed network devices
  • Contributes to the development of customer-facing solutions in coordination with Sales/Sales Engineering, Product/Edge Network Engineering teams to ensure optimal solution and supportability
  • Ensure that all engineering parameters and configurations meet the client’s requirements and are being fulfilled on a timely basis
  • Provide 4th level technical escalation support by providing end-to-end subject matter expertise
  • Design and implement customer functional networks such as LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, QoS, and Security/VPN
  • Collaborate with other Engineers around the globe in the design and deployment of new services and/or enhancements/changes to existing network services
  • Advise and recommend technical solutions that will enhance, increase levels of redundancy, survivability and add flexibility to existing global Speedcast systems, network and VSAT Platforms
  • Coach and mentor team members on complex technical issues to deliver the highest level of service to our customers
  • Assist in strengthening IP expertise within the Edge Network Engineering and Customer Support Teams
  • Assist in the development or improvements of network operational best practices and processes to customer network performance, capacity and scalability
  • Ensures that appropriate action is taken to anticipate, investigate and resolve problems in systems and services. Coordinates the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures. Analyzes patterns and trends
  • Controls, updates and distributes new and revised quality, configuration and services standards, including technical changes, and maintains documentation
What we need from you:
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (BSEE preferred) but will consider candidates with the right combination of relevant work experience or degrees in related fields
  • Must have at least 7 years of network engineering design and operation experience utilizing various networking equipment from Cisco, Palo Alto, Versa Networks, Juniper
  • Must have proven experience in the application of network design, development and implementation techniques in communications systems that involve a variety of hardware and software suites
  • End-to-end knowledge of various access technologies and networking protocols.
  • CCIE certification preferred but may be substituted with equivalent experience and knowledge of routing, switching and Security/VPN
  • Advanced level knowledge and hands on working experience of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, RIPv2), MPLS and SD-WAN
  • Advanced level knowledge and hands on working experience in designing and implementing complex QoS in a Cisco network environment.
  • Extensive experience with Network Security and VPN design and implementation utilizing Cisco and Palo Alto
  • Extensive experience with WAN optimization technology platforms
  • Experience with Newtec Dialog and iDirect VSAT Platform is a plus.
  • Experience with various VSAT antenna systems such as Seatel, Cobham, Intellian, Sailor, Virgin Technologies, Orbit and Kymeta is a plus
  • Experience with various wireless broadband in offshore communication such as LTE, Inmarsat FleetBroadband/BGAN, Iridium
  • Experience with various NMS and ITSM such as Solarwinds, DataMiner and ServiceNow
  • Experience with network packet analyzer tools such as Wireshark, NetFlow or equivalent and bandwidth measurement tool such iPerf or equivalent tool
  • Able to communicate effectively via written and verbal communications.
  • Excellent problem solver, flexible and able to accommodate changing priorities and directions
  • Must be able to interact effectively within all levels of the company
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and function with minimal supervision
  • Research and analytical skills with the ability to collect access and report factual data and present logical conclusions

title: Director of Operations
description:
The Director of Operations serves as the central voice from Operations on issues regarding optimal operational efficiency as related to policy and standards strategy, training and meeting client service initiatives within an Operations environment.
The Director of Operations is a key member of the Operations team that is dedicated to a customer focus work environment.
The Director thrives when working on high profile, detail-oriented projects that result in concrete outputs or outcomes. The Director also enjoys interacting daily with people at different levels in the organization, influencing others without authority and is an effective leader whose personal values are in line with API’s company culture.
The Director of Operations reports to the VP Account Management/Operations.
Essential Functions
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Lead, grow and manage a team of Operations to ensure the correct process, client focus, and communication is conveyed to create exemplary performance for the client.
  • Develops people within the team and across capabilities by coaching, identifying areas for growth, celebrating successes, managing promotion process, keeping an open dialogue with your team, identifying training opportunities.
  • Consistently provides team members guidance, goal setting and performance feedback on a regular basis.
  • Design, implement, and monitor quality training programs within operations.
  • Responsible for the development and implementation of Policy and Standards for the Operations department.
  • Maintains a Standard Operating Procedure Manual (SOP) content, ensuring that it is accessible, understandable and up to date.
  • Strategic planning and execution to enhance profitability, productivity and efficiency throughout the company’s operations.
  • Define API’s Operations resource planning strategy and gain support at all levels of the organization using data, compelling business rationale, and personal influence and credibility.
  • Develop and direct the management of the company’s operations center that will ensure fast booking, processing and communications to the client; accurate reporting, proper and timely reporting in a cost-efficient manner. Implement improved processes and management methods to generate higher ROI and workflow optimization.
  • Ensures Client deliverables are met in accordance with service level agreements.
  • Assist with the development of strategic initiatives for client service improvements.
  • Partner with the Director of Client Delivery to analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of agent utilization and the execution of monthly plans to drive continuous process and agent utilization improvement.
  • Develop and direct the management of the customer operations center to ensure customer satisfaction, improved call efficiency, low abandonment, increased revenue through promotional programs and improved employee product knowledge and training. Implement processes and systems that will generate higher productivity and revenues.
  • Develop and direct the management of the information technology department to ensure that all operational systems are continuously evaluated for proper operation, relevance and utilization. Oversee all company telecommunication systems and support. Ensure that company is migrated toward technology offerings that will generate higher efficiency, enhanced reporting and tracking capabilities and substantial ROI.
  • Interact regularly with executive team and individual department heads to ensure that company’s operational priorities are aligned with total company direction.
  • Continually investigate and introduce process improvement measures and presents suggestions to EVP for consideration.
  • Fully understand the client’s business and ensure all deliverables are being met for a successful relationship
  • Strive to create increased value for the client by providing business reporting and recommendations that are align with desired business goals
  • Become knowledgeable in all API technology platforms to ensure clients are align with appropriate software solution
  • Collaborate with functional departments to ensure business requirements are met.
  • Assist in the development of Operations annual financial budget.

Competencies

  • Problem Solving/Analysis
  • Business Acumen
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Results Driven
  • Leadership
  • Customer Focus
  • Managing Processes
  • Market Knowledge
  • Developing and Maintaining Budgets
  • Technical Capacity
  • Communication Proficiency

Required Education and Experience

  • Established (at least 5 years) of experience in the travel industry and working closely with hotels is a must;
  • Bachelor’s degree;
  • Strong analytical background;

  • Strong implementation and operations experience;
  • Shows attention to detail and the ability to produce high quality work;
  • Strong Microsoft Office computer skills, with emphasis on Excel;
  • An organized self-starter who can work proactively and independently;
  • Able to multi task and work well under strict deadlines and fast paced environment;
  • Demonstrated ability to create and present a business case, including simplifying complex analyses;
  • Demonstrated broad experience leading large cross-functional teams;
  • Outstanding relationship management and customer service orientation skills;
  • Ability to work with and understand diverse cultures here and abroad;
  • A profound understanding of how political, social and cultural differences between countries, people and cultures affect a successful partnership;
  • Flexible to work afterhours based on business demand;
  • English, Portuguese and Spanish fluency (oral and written).

Who We Are

API is the global leader for crew accommodation solutions, and we are changing the way businesses manage travel. Our technology platform streamlines the entire crew planning process, making day-to-day operations more efficient and elevating the crew layover experience. API’s proprietary technology, mobile solutions and our experienced team are positioned to offer our clients a complete, end-to-end platform that integrates seamlessly into their process. We are looking for dynamic, creative, and tech savvy individuals to join our team. If you are passionate about hard work, providing impeccable service, technology, and solutions to our clients then API may be a great fit for you!

description:

O iCities é uma empresa pioneira que busca tornar as cidades mais inteligentes através de projetos e soluções inovadoras no segmento de Cidades Inteligentes. Desenvolvemos projetos e articulamos soluções para a esfera pública, em conjunto com a esfera privada, a fim de desenvolver novas concepções ao desenvolvimento urbano e de promover uma melhor qualidade de vida aos cidadãos. O iCities também é representante exclusivo da FIRA Barcelona, onde trouxe ao Brasil a versão nacional do maior evento mundial de Cidades Inteligentes do mundo, o Smart City Expo World Congress, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento do ecossistema em plena expansão.

Se você é uma pessoa que anseia por mudanças, adora desafios e não tem medo de questionar o convencional, venha se juntar a nós e deixar a sua marca através da área de Operações, Processos e Projetos.

Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Presencial

Atuar como agente estratégico na gestão, otimização e transformação dos processos organizacionais e na condução de projetos estratégicos, assegurando eficiência operacional, sustentabilidade dos negócios e geração de valor para clientes, parceiros e stakeholders.

O Especialista é responsável por liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, transformação digital e gestão de projetos que suportam a missão do iCities de impulsionar soluções para cidades inteligentes.

Gestão de Processos:

  • Gerenciar junto à COO o escopo, cronograma, orçamento, riscos, stakeholders e qualidade dos projetos.

  • Gestão de Processos: BPM, CBPP, Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt ou Black Belt).

  • Vivência em ambientes de inovação, tecnologia, consultorias ou projetos com foco em transformação organizacional.

title: Account Coordinator, Remote
description:
At Bluelight, we are searching for a candidate to join our client's team as a direct hire.

At The Missing Ingredient, we are passionate about building a better future through food. Founded nearly a decade ago by CJ Bruce, with the mission to "uncomplicate marketing for the world’s most impactful food and beverage companies." They specialize in partnering with brands that are conscious about creating healthy food and beverage options and sustainable practices. The team of self-professed foodies and digital marketing nerds is dedicated to exceeding results and driving measurable success for the brands they love.

They focus on digital marketing services for natural food & beverage companies as well as nonprofit organizations.

Their core services include paid media, social media, email marketing, and influencer relations.


Role Overview
  • The Account Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting client account management and ensuring seamless internal operations. Reporting to the Account Manager, this individual will assist with client communication, task coordination, and project support across digital marketing campaigns, social media, and administrative activities. The position is remote and requires ability to work 6 hours overlap in the 9-5 PST.
Key Responsibilities
  • Client & Account Support:
  • Support Account Managers in organizing client deliverables and tracking next steps.
  • Join client calls for note-taking and exposure to client communication.
  • Assist in gathering and preparing materials for client meetings and reports.
  • Maintain up-to-date internal documentation to help Account Managers stay aligned.
  • Step in with administrative or coordination support when Account Managers are out.
  • Offer flexible support to meet the evolving needs of the agency.
  • -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  • Project & Task Coordination:
  • Help track project timelines and ensure internal deadlines are documented.
  • Send friendly reminders to team members about upcoming or overdue tasks.
  • Double-check that briefs and resources are shared before tasks begin.
  • Assist in updating task templates and internal workflows under Account Manager guidance.
  • -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  • Team Collaboration & Communication:
  • Meet weekly with Account Managers to understand challenges and support needs.
  • Check in weekly with internal specialists to surface blockers or support needs.
  • Relay specialist feedback to the Account Manager to help inform planning.
  • Coordinate hand-offs between departments (e.g., creative to paid media) to maintain flow.
  • Help facilitate cross-functional collaboration by keeping communication clear and organized.
Success Measurements
  • Client Satisfaction: Positive feedback and relationship strength with client accounts.
  • Project Delivery: Timeliness and quality of deliverables across campaigns.
  • Internal Coordination: Effective communication and collaboration with internal teams.
  • Task Management: High on-time task completion rate with minimal oversight.
Required Skills & Experience
  • 2-3 years in account coordination, marketing, project management, social media, or related fields.
  • Previous remote work experience and ability to work 6 hours overlap in the 9-5 PST.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Attention to detail and resourceful problem-solving ability.
  • Adaptability to fast-paced environments and openness to feedback.
  • An strong interest in digital marketing and desire to grow in the marketing industry.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and tools like Teamwork, Notion, Slack, and Google Suite.
  • Bonus: Experience in copywriting, content creation, or influencer marketing.
Career Growth & Advancement
  • Potential progression into Account Manager and Senior Account Manager roles based on performance.
  • Opportunities to specialize in client strategy, campaign leadership, or team management with demonstrated proficiency and leadership skills.
Security & Compliance Requirements
  • Adherence to internal confidentiality policies and client-specific data handling requirements.
Reporting & Team Structure
  • Reports directly to the Account Manager.
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with creative, paid media, and influencer marketing teams.

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Oprojeto Acolhidos por meio do trabalho promove a integração de pessoas refugiadas e migrantes venezuelanas por meio de ações de qualificação, empregabilidade e articulação com o setor privado. Santa Catarina é o estado que mais recebe famílias interiorizadas e concentra a maior parte das parcerias com empresas no Brasil. Ribeirão Preto, Brazil | Postado em 02/06/2025

Como Analista de Infraestrutura Cloud, você será responsável por executar atividades que contribuam diretamente para a satisfação do cliente identificando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização contínua dos processos. Seu papel será fundamental para garantir a performance, estabilidade e evolução dos serviços de infraestrutura, promovendo ganhos consistentes para nossos clientes e para a empresa.

  • Atendimentos de tickets de sustentação de servidores Windows e Linux em ambiente em Cloud Oracle OCI.
  • Arquitetura: Liderar o design e desenvolvimento de arquiteturas técnicas, assegurando soluções eficientes, escaláveis e alinhadas às melhores práticas de mercado.
  • Implantação: Coordenar a implantação de soluções técnicas, atuando em parceria com equipes multidisciplinares para garantir entregas dentro do prazo, qualidade e requisitos estabelecidos.
  • Gerenciamento de Incidentes: Gerenciar e solucionar tickets, assegurando o cumprimento dos SLAs e a resolução eficaz dos incidentes para minimizar impactos aos clientes.
  • Monitoramento e Otimização: Monitorar sistemas e ambientes de infraestrutura, analisando dados operacionais para propor melhorias contínuas e antecipar possíveis falhas.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior em andamento em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Matemática, Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação e afins.
  • Administração avançada de Windows Server (Active Directory, GPOs, IIS, troubleshooting, atualizações).
  • Administração e troubleshooting em Linux (Oracle Linux, Ubuntu, Debian, Red Hat), com experiência em scripting (Bash/Shell).
  • Fundamentos sólidos em protocolos e conceitos de redes: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, NAT, firewalls (iptables).
  • Conhecimento em roteamento estático e dinâmico (BGP, OSPF).
  • Domínio dos conceitos de Virtual Cloud Networks (VCNs), tabelas de roteamento, ACLs, load balancers, FastConnect e Dynamic Routing Gateways (DRGs).
  • Experiência comprovada em Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Gestão de recursos na nuvem, criação e configuração de máquinas virtuais (Windows e Linux).
  • Procedimentos de snapshot e backup.
  • Configuração e gerenciamento de redes na camada IaaS (VCNs, Subnets, Gateways).
  • Políticas de segurança e regras específicas da OCI.
  • Conhecimento em Compute (instâncias e formas), Storage (block, object, file storage) e Networking.
Diferenciais
  • Certificações OCI Foundations e Associate
  • Experiência prévia em outras plataformas cloud (AWS, Azure).
  • Conhecimento em automação e infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de logs.
  • R$ 550,00 Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Convênio Médico - 2 opções de operadora sob análise de subsídio;
  • Até R$150,00 de reembolso para curso de inglês;
  • Auxílio mobilidade: R$150,00 para CCMers que comparecerem ao escritório no mínimo 14 dias no mês;
  • Espaço para descanso;
  • Espaço para jogos;
  • R$ 2.000,00 por ano para capacitação profissional - liberado gradualmente após 3 meses de admissão e integral após 1 ano;
  • Plano de carreira bem estruturado;
  • Candidatos de Ribeirão Preto (preferencial): Modelo híbrido 2X por semana home-office;

title: Coordenador de Trade Marketing | Novos Canais São Paulo - SP Full-time employee
description:
Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores indústrias farmacêuticas do Brasil, ser desafiado, aprender e vivenciar uma rotina com times cheios de vontade de fazer acontecer?

Com a oportunidade de Coordenador de Trade Marketing | Novos Canais, vamos proporcionar cada vez mais saúde e bem-estar para todo o Brasil! Vem ser Cimed!

O Coordenador de Trade Marketing Canal será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de trade marketing específicas para novos canais (Alimentar, Departamentos e Perfumaria), garantindo a excelência na execução das marcas no ponto de venda, apoiando o time de vendas e o desenvolvimento da nova BU.

Terá como foco a análise de mercado e desempenho de produtos, utilizando ferramentas como Scanntech para embasar as decisões estratégicas e táticas da área.

As responsabilidades incluem:

  1. Desenvolver relacionamento próximo com a equipe de vendas e clientes de novos canais, garantindo a implementação das estratégias de trade marketing;
  2. Desenvolver e executar planos de Trade Marketing para novos canais, alinhados às estratégias de marca e vendas;
  3. Criar, apresentar e acompanhar o JBP junto aos principais clientes do canal alimentar;
  4. Realizar análises de mercado, sell-out e performance de categorias e produtos, utilizando ferramentas como Scanntech e BI, identificando oportunidades de crescimento;
  5. Coordenar a ativação das campanhas promocionais e ações no PDV, garantindo a implementação e pós-mortem das ativações;
  6. Acompanhar, junto ao time de Trade Execução, os KPIs de execução e performance no PDV, ajustando as estratégias conforme necessário;
  7. Apoiar a negociação e implementação de materiais de PDV com o cliente, alinhado à Trade Categoria;
  8. Coordenar o orçamento da área, garantindo eficiência na alocação de recursos para as ações planejadas.

Requisitos:

  1. Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração, Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Experiência prévia em Trade Marketing, preferencialmente no canal alimentar;
  3. Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de análise de mercado como Scanntech, Nielsen e BI;
  4. Habilidade analítica para interpretar dados de mercado e propor ações estratégicas;
  5. Capacidade de negociação e relacionamento com equipes internas e clientes;
  6. Excel avançado e experiência com apresentações e relatórios gerenciais;
  7. Disponibilidade para viagens, caso necessário.

Etapas do processo:

  1. Avaliação Comportamental
  2. Termo de transparência

Agilidade, inovação, comprometimento e colaboração: isso é ser Cimed!

Somos uma empresa 100% nacional com o sangue amarelo correndo nas veias e queremos que todos, em qualquer canto do país, tenham acesso à saúde de qualidade. Para nós, remédio não tem classe social. Sabemos que o sucesso não aceita preguiça e, com nosso jeito fly now de ser, vivemos o nosso propósito de proporcionar saúde e bem-estar para todos os brasileiros . Com ritmo, rotina e ritual , entregamos sempre o melhor, da nossa família para todas as outras, levando gente no coração para nos tornarmos a maior e melhor farmacêutica do Brasil.

Atuamos de ponta a ponta, desde o recebimento da matéria-prima até a entrega final nas lojas e farmácias. Temos um centro de desenvolvimento e pesquisa, o Instituto Claudia Marques, além de indústria de embalagens, fabricação, frota e centros de distribuição próprios. Hoje, temos a maior cadeia de distribuição de medicamentos do país, chegando a mais de 60 mil pontos de venda por meio de nossos centros de distribuição no DF e em 24 dos 26 estados do Brasil.

Role Overview
  • The Account Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting client account management and ensuring seamless internal operations. Reporting to the Account Manager, this individual will assist with client communication, task coordination, and project support across digital marketing campaigns, social media, and administrative activities. The position is remote and requires ability to work 6 hours overlap in the 9-5 PST.

  • Client & Account Support:

  • -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  • Project & Task Coordination:
  • Help track project timelines and ensure internal deadlines are documented.
  • Send friendly reminders to team members about upcoming or overdue tasks.
  • Double-check that briefs and resources are shared before tasks begin.
  • Assist in updating task templates and internal workflows under Account Manager guidance.
  • -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  • Team Collaboration & Communication:
  • Meet weekly with Account Managers to understand challenges and support needs.
  • Check in weekly with internal specialists to surface blockers or support needs.
  • Relay specialist feedback to the Account Manager to help inform planning.
  • Coordinate hand-offs between departments (e.g., creative to paid media) to maintain flow.
  • Help facilitate cross-functional collaboration by keeping communication clear and organized.
Success Measurements
  • Client Satisfaction: Positive feedback and relationship strength with client accounts.
  • Project Delivery: Timeliness and quality of deliverables across campaigns.
  • Internal Coordination: Effective communication and collaboration with internal teams.
  • Task Management: High on-time task completion rate with minimal oversight.
Required Skills & Experience
  • 2-3 years in account coordination, marketing, project management, social media, or related fields.
  • Previous remote work experience and ability to work 6 hours overlap in the 9-5 PST.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Attention to detail and resourceful problem-solving ability.
  • Adaptability to fast-paced environments and openness to feedback.
  • An strong interest in digital marketing and desire to grow in the marketing industry.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and tools like Teamwork, Notion, Slack, and Google Suite.
  • Bonus: Experience in copywriting, content creation, or influencer marketing.
Career Growth & Advancement
  • Potential progression into Account Manager and Senior Account Manager roles based on performance.
  • Opportunities to specialize in client strategy, campaign leadership, or team management with demonstrated proficiency and leadership skills.
Security & Compliance Requirements
  • Adherence to internal confidentiality policies and client-specific data handling requirements.
Reporting & Team Structure
  • Reports directly to the Account Manager.
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with creative, paid media, and influencer marketing teams.
  • No supervisory responsibilities initially but expected to manage tasks and project timelines independently.
Additional Expectations
  • Active participation in weekly team meetings, training sessions, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Contribution to a positive, solution-oriented team culture.
  • Commitment to professional development and continuous learning in digital marketing trends.
Compensation Structure
  • The compensation philosophy ensures competitive pay aligned with performance, proficiency, and company affordability. Compensation is reviewed annually based on market benchmarks and individual contributions.
  • Location: Remote
  • Employment Type: Full-Time
What The Missing Ingredient Offers
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Flexible paid vacation. (You are responsible for ensuring coverage while out)
  • Annual end-of-year profit sharing based on salary, tenure, and performance. Dependent on agency profitability at at the discretion of agency ownership.
  • Guaranteed minimum 3% salary increase YoY, with additional increases based on performance.

  • Opportunities for professional growth across various digital marketing disciplines.
  • Dynamic, collaborative, and mission-driven team culture.

title: Senior UI Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

As a Senior UI Artist, you will collaborate with UX designers to design features and UX/UI systems by generating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, design systems, and style guides. You will assist the UI Technical Designers and UI Engineers to build out the designs into rapid prototypes and shippable UI to players. In this role, you will have the ability to take wireframes and bring them to life while improving the UX with visuals. You will also implement final art in Unreal Editor using UMG, animations, materials, etc.

In this role, you will

  • Work collaboratively with UX Design, Tech UI Design, and Engineering to create AAA-quality UI experiences
  • Actively participate in the creation and implementation of design systems, game menus, HUD elements, Iconography, UI materials and shaders, UI animation, and motion design
  • Create new material effects, implement basic logic in blueprints, and/or create 2D effects
  • Contribute to shipping high-quality features on time
  • Collaborate with the greater UXUI Department to ensure consistency and quality are maintained across the project
  • Execute at a high-quality bar, work autonomously, and tackle complex features and systems
  • Work in Photoshop, Illustrator, and/or Figma to create concept UI art

What we’re looking for

  • You have 7+ years of experience working collaboratively to see complex UI features through to completion across multiple platforms (mobile, pc, consoles)
  • You have 7+ years of experience working in Agile environments and on multi-disciplinary teams
  • Excellent visual design skills with a strong portfolio
  • You are skilled with Figma, Adobe Suite, or other comparable software
  • A strong portfolio of work showcasing your skills and your process
  • Experience with UI Art implementation, in Unreal Engine (UMG) or equivalent game engine
  • Experience with building UI materials & shaders for game engines, or equivalent 3d packages and FX tools; motion design & UI animation, preferably for games or interaction design
  • You have the ability to see features through to completion and rapidly modify work as information changes
  • You have a passion for making and playing games and have a strong sense of player empathy
  • You are a proactive individual who naturally leans into owning outcomes and is able to deal with ambiguity well and adapt to changes of plan quickly

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

description:
Job description

Responsável por garantir os procedimentos de reposição de estoque e os processos operacionais do Almoxarifado do Expo Center Norte , atuando no recebimento, movimentação, armazenagem, separação, controle e organização dos materiais de estoque e não estoque, assegurando a validade dos materiais, o endereçamento, a identificação e a comunicação com as áreas referente aos recebimentos de fornecedores.

Main responsibilities

  • Monitorar a reposição do estoque de materiais, de acordo com a demanda de itens para operação contínua do Expo Center Norte, garantindo a quantidade de estoque adequada para atender essa operação e as solicitações de reposições, conforme necessidade;
  • Revisar o ponto de pedidos mínimo e máximo periodicamente, de acordo com a referência de período de consumo definida através de análise do mesmo mês de anos anteriores, mantendo atualizado sempre que necessário;
  • Manter os manuais e materiais de procedimentos da área atualizados, a fim de garantir o cumprimento das etapas dos processos;
  • Monitorar o recebimento e a separação dos materiais, controlando e garantindo as quantidades recebidas e entregues, conforme solicitações;
  • Controlar as ordens de compra de reposição de insumos junto aos fornecedores, garantindo estratégia no recebimento dentro do prazo;
  • Desenvolver orçamentos e cotações de materiais de reposição;
  • Inspecionar a data de validade dos materiais de estoque e não estoque, assegurando que estejam dentro do prazo estipulado, caso contrário, descartando de forma adequada;
  • Fiscalizar a organização e limpeza do setor, através de rondas constantes nas prateleiras e depósitos, a fim de auxiliar no processo de conferência para o inventário periódico e anual;
  • Acompanhar o inventário rotativo, através da conferência das movimentações diárias, e conduzir a análise das divergências semanalmente com análises de solicitações e entregas, a fim de conferir as quantidades de materiais disponíveis;
  • Monitorar o controle dos itens “não estoque” direcionados ao Almoxarifado (materiais, equipamentos e mobiliários), revisando com as áreas periodicamente a necessidade, a fim de manter no depósito, reutilizar ou descartar, caso não for útil;
  • Atualizar, analisar e acompanhar os indicadores operacionais da área, a fim de auxiliar na tomada de decisão do negócio durante a apresentação mensal à Gerência do departamento;
  • Oferecer suporte para as demais áreas do negócio, fornecedores e terceiros, através de um bom atendimento interno e externo, esclarecendo dúvidas e fornecendo informações, sempre que solicitado;
  • Apoiar no fortalecimento da cultura de sustentabilidade da empresa, respeitando as diretrizes, normas e políticas socioambientais aplicáveis. Assim, dentro de suas atribuições e responsabilidades, atuar sempre de forma ética, proativa, segura e responsável, minimizando os impactos ambientais, incidentes de trabalho, entre outros.

  • Experiência de 1 a 2 anos na área de Almoxarifado ou atuando em estoque;

description:
Do you enjoy using science to drive change in the world?

Do you have an exceptional eye for accuracy and detail?

About our Team

The Lancet Regional Health – Americas is an open access journal, part of the Lancet's global initiative to advocate for health-care quality and access in all regions of the world. We are an international team, handling high-quality research, reviews, commissions and commentaries to drive thought leadership across all areas of clinical and global public health pertaining to the WHO Americas region. We build close relationships with clinical and research communities to ensure we offer a personalised service to authors while publishing exciting, interesting, and thought-provoking content. We also undertake considerable community engagement and political activities to leverage change.

About the Role

As a Senior Editor, you will work alongside other Senior Editors, a Deputy Editor, and the Editor-in-Chief in all aspects of the organisation and preparation of the journal. You will take ownership of overseeing submissions and performing quality peer review to ensure we publish high-quality content. You will build international relationships with experts in the community to disseminate and discuss practice-changing results from the field.

At the Lancet we are deeply committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment. In our pursuit of excellence, we recognise the strength in varied perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance the diversity of our editorial team, we encourage applications from individuals who bring unique skills, backgrounds, and perspectives to the role.

This is a full-time, fixed term position.

Responsibilities

· Identifying experts to act as peer reviewers on selected submissions

· Commissioning and handling special project content

· Write editorials, organise peer review of research articles and reviews, and conduct webinars and podcasts with authors and key opinion leaders.

· Develop and maintain relationships with medical research communities to solicit high-quality research, particularly clinical trials, for the journal.

· Attending conferences and other events, to represent the journal, to identify suitable topics and authors, and to keep up-to-date with current developments in medical research

· Collaborating with colleagues to improve internal policies and processes

· Liaising with other editors, authors, and production teams to perfect papers for publication

Requirements

· A medical degree in a relevant discipline or a higher degree (PhD) in a relevant discipline (eg, biomedical science, public health, global health)

· Have experience in a relevant field or experience in the wider development community

· Demonstrate editorial experience, with a good understanding of all aspects of the journal publishing process

title: Senior Software Engineer - Interface
description:
Sobre o Stark Bank

No Stark Bank, somos mais que um banco digital para empresas: somos parceiros estratégicos que, desde 2018, vêm redefinindo o futuro dos serviços financeiros corporativos no Brasil. Oferecemos uma gama completa de serviços, desde o processamento ágil de pagamentos e faturas até a gestão inteligente de contas a receber, tudo integrado e automatizado através de uma API robusta e inovadora. Não nos contentamos em apenas otimizar processos; ambicionamos nos tornar o maior banco em tecnologia financeira, capacitando negócios a prosperarem com soluções que eliminam burocracias e impulsionam a eficiência.

Acreditamos que a chave para revolucionar o sistema financeiro reside na nossa busca incessante por inovação e na nossa capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em soluções impactantes. Cada linha de código, cada nova funcionalidade que desenvolvemos, é destinada a permitir que as empresas foquem no que realmente importa: estratégia e crescimento.

Nosso legado é ambicioso: construir o melhor ecossistema bancário em tecnologia e atendimento para empresas no Brasil. E para alcançar essa visão, precisamos de mentes curiosas, persistentes e apaixonadas por desafios. Se você se identifica com a minuciosidade, consistência e persistência que nos movem, se acredita na melhoria constante e coloca o cliente no centro de suas ações, e se busca um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador onde a ambição encontra a oportunidade de escalar, o Stark Bank é o seu lugar.

Nosso time de interface atua nas construção de tecnologias escaláveis para auxiliar nas implementações de nossos produtos para nossos clientes. Você participará do desenvolvimento das soluções de SDK, atuando profundamente na melhoria do produto frente as dores e necessidades dos nossos cliente.


O que você irá fazer:
  • Atuação de forma“You build it, you run it”, sendo responsável pela construção e operação dos serviços criados.
  • Desenvolver microsserviços escaláveis em Python utilizando ferramentas do Google Cloud Platform (AppEngine e CloudRun).
  • Trabalhar com múltiplas linguagens e tecnologias, para nossas soluções de SDK.
  • Contribuir ativamente na concepção e melhoria de produtos, participando de tomadas de decisão.
O que esperamos de você:
  • Dinamismo: Capacidade de se adaptar a um roadmap dinâmico com múltiplas demandas.
  • Vontade de aprender: Interesse genuíno em explorar novas plataformas, ferramentas e tecnologias.

  • Habilidades interpessoais: Comunicação clara e abordagem colaborativa no trabalho em equipe.

  • Espírito de dono.

Salário compatível com o mercado de tecnologia

Bônus atrelado a performance da companhia

No Stark Bank, investimos no seu sucesso e acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho onde você pode prosperar. Além de um ambiente desafiador e inovador, oferecemos:
